document.about: ROCKWOOL Comfortboard 80 technical data sheet (2 pages). Its 36 pt and 26 pt titles carry a small raised ®, and page 2 ends a paragraph on a bold web address.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#122): a line ending in a web address, a domain, an e-mail address or a phone number was a heading when set bold or large.
2026-11-24 (#136): a degree set as a raised `o` read as the letter after a number and a space (`75 oF`).
2026-11-24 (#126): a raised ® beside a display title was dropped or joined a smaller line beside it, because the space glyph the producer set after it decided which line it was.

checks.issue: The bold web address ending the certifications paragraph was a level-5 heading.
The cover title's raised ®, followed by a space glyph at its own size, stood alone and was read as a list marker and dropped.
On page 2 the ® was followed by a space glyph on the header line's baseline, and went to that line.
